children.html:
Master Your Buoyancy Skills

Peak Performance Buoyancy

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-46ce8ef0 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: At Mocean Beach Resort, our Peak Performance Buoyancy course helps certified divers refine control, positioning, and movement underwater. Conducted in the clear, calm waters of West Sumbawa, Indonesia, this course focuses on precision and efficiency to make every dive effortless. With just two divers per instructor, you receive personalized guidance for improving trim, buoyancy, and air consumption. Practice in a diver-centered environment with private lockers, a wet area, and an air-conditioned camera room. Experience the freedom of gliding smoothly over vibrant marine life, including manta rays, reef sharks, and eagle rays.

Your PPB Course

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-18b743a3 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: This one-day course includes two boat dives focused on mastering buoyancy control. Each dive emphasizes controlled movements, precise hovering, and efficient underwater navigation. Divers learn to maintain perfect trim and handle delicate marine environments with care, enhancing both confidence and control beneath the surface. By the end of the course, you’ll be confident in your underwater control and ready to tackle advanced dives with ease.

Drift and Unwind

Relax, Recharge, and Discover Sumbawa

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-6e8760af elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Your dive adventure doesn’t end when you surface. Mocean Beach Resort offers quiet beaches, breathtaking sunsets, and easy access to Sumbawa’s hidden gems. Spend an afternoon exploring nearby villages, trek to cascading waterfalls, or simply unwind with a spa treatment after a day of diving. Whether you crave exploration or pure relaxation, our boutique setting lets you enjoy Indonesia’s natural beauty at your own pace. Every stay is designed to refresh your body and inspire your next dive.

Experience More Than Diving

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-387bdaa5 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Beyond the crystal-clear waters, Sumbawa invites you to explore its wild side. Hike scenic coastal trails, visit traditional fishing villages, or take a day trip to secluded beaches where you can swim, snorkel, and soak in untouched beauty. For those seeking culture, local markets and ceremonies reveal the island’s rich heritage. Whether you’re chasing adrenaline or peaceful escapes, every moment here adds a new layer to your Indonesian journey.

children.html:
Who can take the PPB course?

Any certified diver can join, whether you’re Open Water certified or have advanced experience.

What skills will I learn?

You’ll refine buoyancy, trim, finning techniques, and air consumption to glide smoothly and efficiently underwater.

How large are the training groups?

Groups are limited to two divers per instructor for personalized guidance and hands-on practice.

Where does the training take place?

The course combines controlled exercises and open water dives in calm, clear waters around West Sumbawa.

What facilities support the course?

Our dive center provides private lockers, wet areas, and an air-conditioned camera room for equipment and comfort.
